title: Ananias the false Prophet
summary: Raleigh names Ananias the false Prophet in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Ananias the false Prophet, who brake the woodden Chaine which Ieremie ware, and died in the second moneth. He is not the Ananias taken with Daniel. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXVIII, §. VI, sig. 379a–379b
